evidence: Inspected full body and indexed caller. The function initializes fields of an output record, queries context selectors 0x13 and 4, checks related attribute predicates, loads a context value and performs floating-point remapping before tail-calling another helper. The exact result/domain meaning is unresolved, so it remains unnamed. Source: decompiled/main/main_0012.c:9439-9569; caller decompiled/main/main_0018.c:15806-15810.

Checks attribute-context status selector 0x19, tests whether a nested provider float is nonzero, then derives a float from context fields at +0x24/+0x25 and +0/+4 using curve/remap helpers; stores the float through the output pointer and returns its integer conversion. Indexed caller invokes it twice with mode values 1 and 0 and a shared selector/index argument. Source: decompiled/main/main_0014.c:32841-32992; caller decompiled/main/main_0014.c:27805-27809,28155-28159.

For a nonnull record, gets a base rating, obtains its average attribute rating, computes an individual attribute rating, and combines the values with floating-point scaling. It also clamps/conditions the rating using a record byte and configuration values before returning a float. Caller uses the result in two rating-comparison paths. Source: decompiled/main/main_0057.c:6677-6817; caller decompiled/main/main_0057.c:6387-6395. Callee semantics are supported by accepted annotations at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv for compute_attribute_rating_from_record and compute_average_attribute_rating.

Uses the global context object and a mode/type field from the input record to choose one of several related-attribute paths. The visible branches request fixed selectors including 0x3e, 5, and 0x42 through the accepted aggregate_related_attribute_values helper and sum float results; other paths fetch nested provider values for a selected slot kind. The caller adds the returned float to an accumulated score at +0x80. Source: decompiled/main/main_0072.c:43591-43733; caller decompiled/main/main_0072.c:43417-43421; helper names corroborated by tools/data/function_annotations.tsv and decompiled/function_behavior.tsv.

Validates the supplied index (0 through 0x12), resolves/defaults an attribute record, and for successive slot indices invokes the indexed record helpers, including writes associated with record offsets 0x48, 0x36, and 0x3c. It returns the accumulated byte/flag result; its caller uses bit 7 and invokes it again after a guarded record operation. Source: decompiled/main/main_0033.c:3501-3633; caller decompiled/main/main_0033.c:3855-3902. Indexed callee behavior is documented in tools/data/function_annotations.tsv.
